checkpoints.headline: The check-box half of the FIX132 repair is real and I confirm it: 17 of the bundle's 21 selection widgets and 77 of the inserts' 78 are pixel-identical to the source and the doubled concentric frame is gone everywhere. The other half is not. 27981 dark pixels of the Coalition for Court Access's own printed ink are missing from the delivered pages - every writing rule in the FACTS/FINDINGS offence grid, every rule in Exhibit A's seven-row disposition table, and the twelve-underscore blank the source's DD-cap-CourtType widget paints on all four caption pages - and 2632 of them lie outside every source widget rect, so the commit's 'Removed ink not accounted to a selection widget: 0' is false on the bytes it shipped. Rendering the pre-repair inserts gives the identical removal counts, so the repair removed synthesized ink and left every erased pixel where it was. Separately, the refusal of participant.street_address from the proposed order's page-14 service list is correct on the bytes and incomplete as a remedy: the 32 blank rules it leaves are disclosed to the participant nowhere, and step 8 of the guide tells them that block is the court's and to leave it alone.
checkpoints.alsoRecorded: The guide tells an arrest-track participant that 'the committed record' allows early filing 'on the written agreement of the prosecuting attorney' and sets the wait at 'one year from the arrest, charge or allegation, whichever is later'. Neither string exists anywhere in track in_arrest_no_charges, whose only waitingPeriods entry is 'The arrest, with no charges pending / One year'. Both belong to the sibling track in_section1_petition. The guide also contradicts its own eligibility paragraph nineteen lines earlier.
checkpoints.contradictsACommittedRecord: MASTER_QUEUE.json publishes visualDefects 0, allNineCountersZero true and completenessStatus PASS_COMPLETE for this family. I measure 50 discrete widget or region instances where the delivered ink differs from the source's.

checkpoints.headline: Measured on this family's own bytes, not inherited from its sibling, and it lands in the same place for the same reasons plus one of its own. The check-box repair holds: 17 of 21 bundle selection widgets and 77 of 78 insert selection widgets are pixel-identical to the pinned source and no check box shows a doubled frame. The page-14 write into List-MailingAddresses_LEA is genuinely refused - delivered page 14 diffs to exactly 0 against the source in both directions - and is disclosed to the participant nowhere, while step 8 of the guide tells them the order's agency directions are the court's. 27981 dark pixels of the Coalition's own printed ink are still missing from the delivered pages, 2632 of them outside every source widget rect, against a commit message stating 'Removed ink not accounted to a selection widget: 0'.
checkpoints.whatDistinguishesItFromItsSibling: Nothing in the filing. This family's packet-boundary-filled.pdf is the SAME FILE as in_arrest_no_charges-set's (0e39d7c6..., 250876 bytes) and all four insert fixtures across both families are one file (f06f7dbb...). The canonical packets differ by one byte: three flattened appearances render at /Helvetica 12 Tf here and /Helvetica 11 Tf there, over character-identical text, because the two builders reached the same clipping fix by different mechanisms. Everything that actually differs is in the participant guide - title, eligibility, statute subsection, waiting period, self-help list form, route footer - four hunks in 189 lines.
checkpoints.alsoRecorded: This family's guide is the better of the two on self-help: it cites the registry by path and reproduces all thirteen stop conditions verbatim. And its waiting-period and prosecutor-agreement statements are true of ITS registry - the same sentences are false in the sibling's guide, which is failed there under ROUTE_IDENTITY.
checkpoints.contradictsACommittedRecord: MASTER_QUEUE.json publishes visualDefects 0, allNineCountersZero true and completenessStatus PASS_COMPLETE for this family. CLONED_FAMILY_PACKETS.json records the clone against digests that the repair has superseded, so every digest in that record is now stale while the finding it reports has got stronger.
